items.title: New AmnesiaStealer macOS malware hijacks browser sessions via remote control
items.description: A new information-stealing malware called AmnesiaStealer, which targets macOS users via ClickFix attacks, includes a streaming module that allows the attacker to interactively control the victim's web browser. [...]

items.title: McDonald’s, Vodafone Hit by Azure Credential Theft Campaign Exposing Millions of Enterprise Records
items.description: A sprawling Azure data exfiltration campaign is unfolding across the dark web, with a threat actor systematically selling off internal employee directories stolen from some of the world’s largest corporations. The seller, operating under the alias “TheHatman,” claims to have pulled these records directly from victim organizations’ Azure and Entra tenants using compromised credentials, and […]…
